reviews.review: "Oh my gosh, I actually beat this game! Okay, I'm going to be very honest about this game, Immortal: Unchained.This game was created by a development team that had very high ambitions, but lacked the talent to be able to put them into a video game—at least properly. The gunplay in the game is not very interesting. As time goes on through the game, your skills, the types of guns you get, and moderators will increase your handling abilities and your abilities in general. But the problem is that as you continue along with the game, you figure it out: the game is not only very buggy, but also has not been appropriately patched as time goes on.The game itself feels empty. For a video game publisher like this one to come out with a game this unfinished really pisses me off. But at the same time, I see where they're going with it. I understand that the game itself is fun, and the type of story they're trying to push is unique and different compared to other Souls-like games you will find.Even with all of the issues with optimization and controls, I still played this game like crazy. I still enjoyed myself with what I had. I still felt I got my money's worth. I just wish that the developers put in more time and effort to optimize the game better, and to fix some of the bugs and issues that are still plaguing the game today.I'm going to give Immortal: Unchained a solid 3 out of 5. It's not a game you have to play, but when it's on sale, you should pick it up. Let's hope for a sequel because of the way they ended. Since they learned their lesson and did a better job with the sequel, I'm going to give this game a thumbs-up—but understand that it's only a three-out-of-five thumbs-up. Do better."
